title: Each call pauses at the recursive call; the answer is built on the way back up
caption: digit_sum(n) = n % 10 + digit_sum(n // 10), with digit_sum(n) = n for a single digit.

messages.label: digit_sum(4987)
messages.note: A new frame is pushed with its own n.

messages.label: digit_sum(498)
messages.note: last = 7 is kept in this frame, which now waits.

messages.label: digit_sum(4)
messages.note: last = 9, waiting… Four frames are on the stack now.
Base case: a single digit returns itself. Nothing was combined on the way down.
The paused frame resumes and combines its own digit with the result.
The last frame pops; the stack is empty again.
